replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: PCA is a statistical procedure that uses an orthogonal transformation to convert a set of observations of possibly correlated variables into a set of values of linearly uncorrelated variables called principal components. It involves mean centering the data, calculating the covariance matrix, computing eigenvalues and eigenvectors, sorting eigenvectors by eigenvalues in descending order, and choosing the top k eigenvectors as principal components. The math can seem daunting, but there are many tools and software that can do the heavy lifting for you.
